18. (17分)
(1) 设关于 $x$ 的方程 $tx^2+(1-t)x+t-1=0$ 有两个不相等的实数根 $x_1,x_2$。
① 求 $t$ 的取值集合；
② 若 $x_1^2+x_2^2=3$，求 $t$ 的值。
(2) 求关于 $x$ 的不等式 $tx^2+(1-t)x+t-1<t$（$t$ 为常数且 $t\in\mathbb{R}$）的解集。

handwritten_answer.text:
(1) _未识别到手写答案。_
(2) $\{x\mid -\frac{1}{t}<x<1\}$
当 $t<-1$ 时，$\{x\mid x>1 \text{ 或 } x<-\frac{1}{t}\}$
$t=-1$ 时，$\{x\mid x\neq 1\}$
$-1<t<0$ 时，$\{x\mid x>-\frac{1}{t} \text{ 或 } x<1\}$
handwritten_answer.evidence_note: C003 shows four retained answer lines for (2) matching the draft: {x|-1/t<x<1}, the t<-1 case, the single-case line with {x|x!=1}, and the -1<t<0 case preceded by a struck-out token that the draft correctly omits; part (1) work is only uncircled scratch (circled t!=0, -3t^2+2t+1>0 expansions) with no clean answer, matching the draft placeholder.

questions.question_markdown:
19. (17分) 已知 $a,b,c,d$ 均为正实数。
(1) 证明：$\dfrac{a^2}{c}+\dfrac{b^2}{d}\geq\dfrac{(a+b)^2}{c+d}$。
(2) 若 $a+2b=ab$，求 $\dfrac{4}{a^2+2a}+\dfrac{1}{2b^2+b}$ 的最小值。
(3) 若 $a+2b+3c=\sqrt{6}$，求 $a^2+2b^2+6c^2$ 的最小值。

handwritten_answer.text:
(1) $\dfrac{a^2}{c}+\dfrac{b^2}{d}-\dfrac{(a+b)^2}{c+d}$
$=\dfrac{a^2d(c+d)+b^2c(c+d)-(a+b)^2cd}{cd(c+d)}$
$=\dfrac{a^2d^2+b^2c^2-2abcd}{cd(c+d)}$
$=\dfrac{(ad-bc)^2}{cd(c+d)}\geq 0$，当且仅当 $ad=bc$ 时
(2) $\dfrac{\left(\frac{2}{a}\right)^2}{1+\frac{2}{a}}+\dfrac{\left(\frac{1}{b}\right)^2}{2+\frac{1}{b}}\geq\dfrac{\left(\frac{2}{a}+\frac{1}{b}\right)^2}{1+2+\frac{2}{a}+\frac{1}{b}}$
$\geq\dfrac{1}{4}$
(3) _未识别到手写答案。_
handwritten_answer.evidence_note: C004 retains the (1) difference-of-fractions derivation over cd(c+d) ending in a squared binomial over cd(c+d) >= 0 with the ad=bc equality note, and the (2) chain of stacked fractions ending in >= 1/4, matching the draft line by line; part (3) has only the scratch row a 4b 2c under the printed stem, so the draft placeholder stands.
